McDonald's Collection 2019

Released October 15, 2019 · 12 cards

Expanded

McDonald's Collection 2019 is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the Other series, released in English on October 15, 2019. It has 12 cards. It includes 12 Pokémon, 0 Trainer and 0 Energy cards, and is legal in the Expanded format (rotated out of Standard).
